Continue ck3chronicle from the standalone repository's current handoff.

1. Verify the current Git root is the checkout containing this prompt and that
   its canonical remote is `https://github.com/ck3user75233/ck3chronicle.git`.
2. Read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/CURRENT_HANDOFF.md`, `docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md`, and
   `docs/PROJECT_PLAN.md`.
3. Search the ownership locations in `docs/WORKSPACE_ROUTING.md` before adding
   code. Extend the promoted learner under `tools/template_learning/`; do not
   create or edit ck3chronicle implementation under `ck3raven` or WIP.
4. Keep unknown, L1-only, provisional, and low-confidence assignments visible
   for periodic human review. Do not treat 100% attribution as a requirement.
5. Implement the next in-scope plan item, run focused and full regression
   tests, update the current handoff when workflow/ownership changes, and
   commit only in this repository.
